_comment: Livox-SDK2 device config for the Mid360 on the G1. HARDWARE ONLY -- nothing in
Ours rather than the driver's own config/MID360_config.json, because that file lives in
the vcs-imported checkout: it is gitignored, and scripts/import-externals.sh overwrites
it. A robot-specific IP address cannot live somewhere that a re-import silently reverts.
The addresses are the G1's onboard network. The host is the computer running this driver;
on the robot's own Orin that is 192.168.123.164, and the Mid360 ships from Unitree at
192.168.123.120. Both are worth checking with `livox_viewer` or a ping before blaming the
driver -- Livox's own default subnet is 192.168.1.x, which is what upstream ships.
extrinsic_parameter stays identity ON PURPOSE, even though the sensor is mounted upside
down. The mount belongs in the URDF (mid360_joint, rpy pi 0.0511 0), where TF, RViz and
MoveIt all already read it; baking it in here too would apply the inversion twice.
